title_es: Madurez del Equipo y Mejora Continua
body_es: La madurez de un equipo Agile evoluciona a través de etapas: Forming (conformación, donde se establecen roles), Storming (tormenta, con conflictos iniciales), Norming (normalización, donde emerge cohesión) e Ideating (idealización, cuando el equipo realiza su potencial completo). Los equipos maduros practican la mejora continua mediante retrospectivas frecuentes donde identifican y experimentan con cambios de proceso. La métrica clave es el número de mejoras implementadas y su impacto en la velocidad, calidad y satisfacción. Un equipo maduro no solo entrega software, sino que constantemente examina cómo trabaja y se adapta para ser más efectivo.
body_en: An Agile team's maturity evolves through stages: Forming (where roles are established), Storming (with initial conflicts), Norming (where cohesion emerges), and Ideating (when the team realizes its full potential). Mature teams practice continuous improvement through frequent retrospectives where they identify and experiment with process changes. A key metric is the number of improvements implemented and their impact on velocity, quality, and satisfaction. A mature team not only delivers software but constantly examines how it works and adapts to be more effective.
example_output:
Team Alpha Maturity Assessment:

Current Stage: Norming (Month 6)
Team Health Score: 4.2/5

Velocity Progression:
Month 1: 15-25 pts/sprint (unstable)
Month 2: 28-35 pts/sprint (stabilizing)
Month 3: 38-42 pts/sprint (consistent)
Month 4: 40-43 pts/sprint (stable)
Month 5: 41-44 pts/sprint (predictable)
Month 6: 42-45 pts/sprint (high)

Continuous Improvement Results:

Sprint 20 Improvements:
✓ Automated deployment process (-30 min per release)
✓ Code review standards established
✓ Testing automation started
→ Result: 8% velocity improvement, 25% faster releases

Sprint 21 Improvements:
✓ Pair programming for complex features
✓ Better definition of ready for stories
→ Result: 60% fewer bugs, 40% clearer requirements

Sprint 22 Improvements:
✓ Extended testing coverage (-80% bugs)
✓ Retrospectives moved to mid-sprint for faster feedback
→ Result: Quality improved, team morale up 40%

Projected Stage 4 (Performing): Month 8-10
Expected Velocity: 50-55 pts/sprint
Ready for: Team expansion or mentoring other teams
